response.justification: The candidate lacks any demonstrable C++ experience on Windows platforms, fixed income or capital markets domain expertise, and SQL Server/Oracle proficiency — all mandatory requirements. Their background is overwhelmingly in web, mobile, and open-source tools using TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and JavaScript, with no evidence of financial systems development or Windows-based C++ work.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience
Demonstrated passion for open-source and technical education
Extensive DevOps and CI/CD exposure across multiple environments
concerns: No evidence of C++ development on Windows platform
No experience in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domains
SQL experience listed but no mention of SQL Server or Oracle
